## Undergraduate Thesis *(in preparation)*

**Neuropsychological Assessment in Patients with Schizophrenia**

This thesis examines the neuropsychological profiles of patients diagnosed with schizophrenia 
undergoing multidisciplinary treatment. The work integrates clinical assessment data with current 
literature on cognitive impairment and treatment outcomes. Manuscript currently being prepared 
for submission.
